rainfall.dataset: Rainfall Daily IMD - DistrictWise Daily IMD
rainfall.portal: National Water Data Portal / National Water Informatics Centre (NWIC), Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India
rainfall.note: The portal states this dataset contains observed rainfall measurements collected by IMD. The ZIP does not fabricate or substitute rainfall values.

rainfall.producer: Goa Water Department / Goa SW GW
rainfall.note: Official hourly rainfall source. Use the station-level records relevant to the Dudhsagar/nearby catchment only after checking station location.

emergency_contacts.name: Goa Forest Department - South Goa 24x7 Helpline

site_context.statement: Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary and Bhagwan Mahavir National Park form Goa's largest contiguous wildlife protected area; the Forest Department identifies Dudhsagar Falls as an attraction within this protected area.
The official management-plan material states that the Dudhsagar river originates in/flows through the protected-area context and the surrounding protected area has a network of streams.
Government of Goa currently lists the Dudhsagar tourist circuit as closed for tourists; this is current as of September 5, 2026.
